svg.title: Remove the cokernel component before inverting
svg.desc: Exact Gaussian input, its rank-one projection and their difference. Positive frequency removes a source component; negative frequency removes a solution component.

g.text: The missing inverse is exactly a projection
L E = I − P and E L = I
L E = I and E L = I − P
Choose the solution perpendicular to ker L.
D1–K2: exact fiber identities for odd k.
The corrected forcing has zero exp(−r²/2)-weighted integral. Its pointwise sign changes.
The plotted profiles are exact analytic functions; the proof does not depend on numerical sampling.
